# foreman_discovery_rule (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_discovery_rule" "example" {
  name = "example-rule-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the discovery_rule to look up.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `hostgroup_id` (Number)
- `hostname` (String)
- `hosts_limit` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `priority` (Number)
- `search` (String)
